emulated_instruction.description: Unicorn instruction/function emulation of the repaired function for stack-bound copy sinks.  The emulated oracle only models in-bounds cases that exit 0: guard/reject semantics (a candidate exit status of 1 on an over-limit input) cannot be represented, so non-stack destinations must never reuse this oracle.

native_poc.description: External PoC/regression differential executed natively or in a guest runtime.  This is the declared evidence model for non-stack (heap/global) destinations and for hosts without an instruction-level runtime; no fabricated runtime evidence is allowed when the runner is unavailable.

native_poc_rewrite.description: External PoC/regression differential plus byte-re-derived in-place rewrite actions (reviewed duplicated-capacity-check rewrite); every rewrite action is re-derived from the original and candidate bytes by the gate.
